label: 120 fictional entries. Expected values use hand-entered dated rates and independent integer arithmetic. Actual-source verification is not broker review, legal approval or proof of universal coverage.
assumptions: Declared ordinary consumption, customs value, HTS and origin; no unsupported additional duty or product-specific program exception. Positive exclusion qualification decisions are explicitly synthetic.
